I can't tell if this is a question, or a push to look at the blog post...

The only difference between a mossberg 500 and 590 is that the 500 has a plastic trigger group. Across 50 years, or 50,000 rounds, it may break.

they are both easy to disassemble and clean, they both go bang every time you pull the trigger. Police use 870s, military use 590s. I've owned both. Honestly, I prefer the aesthetic of the mossberg with an 8 round tube and flush barrel over the 870, but the 870 has neat mag-tube accessories, like extended mags and flashlights. You can also buy a little plug for the mossberg that lets you run aguila mini-shells... 870s will not run them reliably.

If I had to pick one, I'd buy the cheaper of the two... used.
